info.name: Tutti API
info.description:
Postman collection for the Tutti (Harmonie) music association management API.

This API provides endpoints for managing users, music pieces, rehearsals, concerts, settings, and more.

item.name: Auth
item.description: Authentication endpoints for login, logout, password management, and MFA

request.description: Authenticate user and get JWT token. If MFA is enabled, provide the mfaCode.
Get current authenticated user profile with instruments and orchestras.
Change password for authenticated user.
Request a password reset email.
Reset password using reset token from email.
Validate a password reset token before using it.
Generate MFA secret and QR code for setup.
Verify MFA code and enable MFA for the user.
Disable MFA (requires password confirmation).
Get current MFA status for authenticated user.

item.name: Users
item.description: User management endpoints (admin only for most operations)

request.description: Get all users with pagination. Admin only.
Get single user by ID. Admin only.
Create a new user. Admin only. Role can be: admin, music_committee, member
Update user. Admin only.
Delete user. Admin only. Cannot delete yourself.
Public member directory (Smoelenboek). All authenticated users can see.
Get a user's profile photo.

formdata.description: Profile photo (PNG, JPG, or WebP, max 2MB)

request.description: Upload a profile photo for a user. Admin only.
Export all user data for GDPR/AVG compliance.

item.name: Music Pieces
item.description: Music piece management including upload, download, and metadata

query.description: Filter by instrument ID (use __none__ for pieces without instrument)

request.description: Get all music pieces. Regular members only see pieces for their instruments.
Get music pieces for current user's instruments and orchestras.
Get all unique titles with piece counts. Admin/Music Committee only.
Get or create title metadata. Admin/Music Committee only.

body.raw:
{
  "title": "Song Title",
  "arranger": "Arranger Name",
  "youtubeUrl": "https://youtube.com/watch?v=...",
  "description": "Description of the piece",
  "durationSeconds": 240,
  "grade": "3",
  "isShared": false,
  "internalNotes": "Internal notes",
  "genreIds": []
}

request.description: Update title metadata (YouTube, description, duration, genres, sharing). Admin/Music Committee only.
Upload a music piece PDF. Admin/Music Committee only.
Upload a ZIP file with multiple PDFs for bulk import. Admin/Music Committee only.
Download the PDF file for a music piece.
Update music piece metadata. Admin/Music Committee only.
Delete a music piece. Admin only.
Bulk update multiple pieces. Admin/Music Committee only.
Bulk delete multiple pieces. Admin only.

item.name: Rehearsals
item.description: Rehearsal management including scheduling, attendance, and repertoire

request.description: Get rehearsals. Regular members only see rehearsals for their orchestras.

query.description: Number of upcoming rehearsals to return

request.description: Get the next N upcoming rehearsals.
Get a single rehearsal with pieces and attendance.
Create a rehearsal. Admin/Music Committee/Conductor only. Type: regular, extra, cancelled
Update a rehearsal. Admin/Music Committee/Conductor only.
Delete a rehearsal. Admin/Music Committee/Conductor only.
Set pieces for a rehearsal (replaces all existing pieces).
Get attendance summary per person for a date range.
Get default rehearsal days (recurring schedule).
Add a default rehearsal day. dayOfWeek: 0=Sunday, 1=Monday, etc.
Update a default rehearsal day.
Delete a default rehearsal day.
Generate rehearsals for a date range from default days.
Create recurring rehearsals from an RRULE.

query.description: Set to true to only delete future rehearsals

request.description: Delete all rehearsals in a recurring series.

Get single concert with full details including program, media, and attendance.

request.description: Create a new concert. Admin/Music Committee only.
Update a concert. Admin/Music Committee only.
Delete a concert. Admin only.
Add item to concert program.
Update a program item.

Reorder program items.
Get concert types and media types.

item.name: Settings
item.description: Association settings including branding, theme, and SMTP configuration

request.description: Get association settings including name, logo, and theme.
Update association settings. Admin only.
Get theme settings. Public endpoint (needed for login page).
Update theme settings. Admin only. Set theme to null to reset.
Get public branding (logo + name). Public endpoint.

formdata.description: Logo file (PNG, JPG, SVG, or WebP, max 2MB)

request.description: Upload association logo. Admin only.
Remove association logo. Admin only.
Serve logo file. Public endpoint.
Get SMTP configuration. Admin only.
Save SMTP configuration. Admin only.
